# Spec: Case-insensitive note search

## Problem
`search()` in `quillnotes/search.py` (lines 1-3) tests `query in n.title or query in n.body`, which is case-sensitive. Both callers, `search_view` in `quillnotes/routes.py` and `cmd_search` in `quillnotes/cli.py`, call it directly, so the web box and `quill search` both miss "Invoice 2026" for the query "invoice".

## Approach
Add a new module `quillnotes/textnorm.py` with `normalize(text) -> str` (`text.casefold()` after Unicode NFKC normalisation) and make `search()` compare `normalize(query)` against `normalize(n.title)` and `normalize(n.body)`. `normalize` is exported so the tag filter can reuse it later.

## Alternatives rejected
- `str.lower()`: leaves "STRASSE" unable to find "Straße".
- A SQLite FTS5 index: the notes live in memory, so an index is a second source of truth for one comparison.

## Out of scope
The tag filter, highlighting matches in the results page, ranking.

## Verification
In `tests/test_search.py`: `test_search_is_case_insensitive_on_title`, `test_search_is_case_insensitive_on_body`, `test_search_casefolds_german_eszett`.
